    E = E[[starts_before(y, p, cutoff) == "yes" for y, p in zip(E["year_from"], E["year_from_precision"])]]
    labels = E["name"].map(classify_association)
    rows = [(label, int(labels.map(lambda found, lab=label: lab in found).sum()))
            for label in ASSOCIATION_PATTERNS]
    rows += [("unclassified", int((labels.str.len() == 0).sum())),
             ("more than one label", int((labels.str.len() > 1).sum())),
             (f"all ensembles starting before {cutoff}", len(E))]
    counts = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["association", "ensembles"])
    counts["share"] = (counts["ensembles"] / max(len(E), 1)).round(3)
    return counts, E.loc[labels.str.len() == 0, "name"].value_counts()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The chronicle — one note per line, most of them opening with a date
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Every date is read as an *interval* for when the activity started, [start_lo, start_hi],
# and one for when it ended, [end_lo, end_hi]; an unknown bound is NaN.  `1895` is
# [1895, 1895]; `189x` [1890, 1899]; `koncem 19. stol.` [1890, 1899] (D-254 Q9); `před 1900`
# [NaN, 1899]; `po 1900` [1900, NaN].  :func:`attests_before` reads all of them with
# one rule, so no form is folded into another.
CIRCA_YEARS = 5     # `kolem 1850` is read as 1845–1855: a judgement call (D-137)

_Y = r"(?:1\d\d\d|20[0-2]\d|1\d\d[xX]|20[0-2][xX]|1\d[xX]{2})(?!\d)"
_MONTHS = r"(?:ledna|února|března|dubna|května|června|července|srpna|září|října|listopadu|prosince)"
_DAY_MONTH = rf"(?:\d{{1,2}}\.\s*(?:\d{{1,2}}\.|{_MONTHS})\s*)?"
_DASH = r"\s*[-–—]\s*"

# The part of a century or a decade a phrase names, as (first, last) offsets into it.
# D-254 Q9: a century's end is its last decade, its middle the half-century ±5 (as `kolem`)
_CENTURY_PART = {"whole": (0, 99), "early": (0, 19), "mid": (45, 55), "late": (90, 99),
                 "first_half": (0, 49), "second_half": (50, 99), "turn": (90, 109)}
_DECADE_PART = {"whole": (0, 9), "early": (0, 3), "mid": (3, 6), "late": (7, 9),
                "first_half": (0, 4), "second_half": (5, 9), "turn": (7, 12)}
# (modifier, part, direction) — longest first, so `od konce` is not read as `od`
_MODIFIERS = [
    (r"na\s+přelomu|přelom", "turn", "in"),
    (r"od\s+konce", "late", "from"),
    (r"od\s+(?:počátku|začátku|zač\.|poč\.)", "early", "from"),
    (r"od\s+(?:1\.|první)\s*pol(?:\.|oviny)", "first_half", "from"),
    (r"od\s+(?:poloviny|pol\.)", "mid", "from"),
    (r"od\s+2\.\s*pol(?:\.|oviny)", "second_half", "from"),
    (r"do\s+konce", "late", "until"),
    (r"do\s+(?:poloviny|pol\.)", "mid", "until"),
    (r"koncem|na\s+konci|ke\s+konci|konec", "late", "in"),
    (r"začátkem|počátkem|na\s+(?:začátku|počátku|zač\.|poč\.)|zač\.|poč\.|začátek|počátek",
     "early", "in"),
    (r"(?:ve?\s+)?(?:1\.|první)\s*pol(?:\.|ovin\w*)", "first_half", "in"),
    (r"(?:ve?\s+)?(?:2\.|druh\w+)\s*pol(?:\.|ovin\w*)", "second_half", "in"),
    (r"v\s+polovině|v\s+pol\.|polovinou|kolem\s+poloviny|v\s+půli", "mid", "in"),
    (r"od", "whole", "from"),
    (r"do", "whole", "until"),
    (r"v\s+průběhu|v\s+období|v\s+době|během|ve|v|za", "whole", "in"),
]
_MODIFIER = "|".join(f"(?:{pattern})" for pattern, _, _ in _MODIFIERS)
# several units — `20., 30. a 40. letech`, `od 50. do 80. let`, `koncem 18. a počátkem 19.
# stol.`; a later unit may carry its own modifier, and the end is read as the whole of it
_JOIN = rf"\s*(?:,|a|do\s+konce|do|-|–|až|/)\s*(?:(?:{_MODIFIER}|patrně\s+i)\s*)?"
_PERIOD = re.compile(
    rf"^(?:(?P<mod>{_MODIFIER})\s*)?(?:"
    rf"(?P<d1>\d0)\.?(?:{_JOIN}(?P<d2>\d0)\.?)*\s*(?:léta|let|letech|létech)\b"
    r"(?:\s*(?P<dc>\d{1,2})\.\s*(?:stol\.|století|stol\b|st\.))?"
    rf"|(?P<c1>\d{{1,2}})\.(?:{_JOIN}(?P<c2>\d{{1,2}})\.)*\s*(?:stol\.|století|stol\b|st\.))",
    re.I)

_WAR1 = r"(?:1\.|první|I\.)\s*(?:svět\.|sv\.|světov\w*)\s*(?:v\s*\.|vál[kc]\w*)"
_WAR2 = r"(?:2\.|druh\w*|II\.)\s*(?:svět\.|sv\.|světov\w*)\s*(?:v\s*\.|vál[kc]\w*)"
_ERAS = [   # (pattern, start interval, end interval)
    (rf"před\s+{_WAR1}", (np.nan, 1913), None),
    (rf"(?:za|během|v\s+době|v\s+průběhu|v\s+letech)\s+{_WAR1}", (1914, 1918), None),
    (rf"po\s+{_WAR1}", (1918, np.nan), None),
    (r"(?:za|od|v\s+době|v\s+období|během)\s+(?:1\.|první)\s+republiky", (1918, 1938), None),   # D-254 Q2
    (rf"před\s+{_WAR2}", (np.nan, 1938), None),
    (rf"(?:za|během|v\s+době|v\s+průběhu|v\s+letech)\s+{_WAR2}"
     r"|(?:za|během|v\s+době)\s+(?:okupace|protektorátu)", (1939, 1945), None),
    (rf"po\s+{_WAR2}|po\s+osvobození", (1945, np.nan), None),
]
_ERA_PATTERNS = [(re.compile(rf"^(?:{p})", re.I), start, end) for p, start, end in _ERAS]

# word + year: (pattern, form)
_WORD_YEAR = re.compile(
    r"^(?:(?:patrně|snad|zřejmě|údajně|prý|asi)\s+(?=od|do|před|po|kolem|v\s))?"
    r"(?P<word>koncem|začátkem|počátkem|od\s+roku|od\s+r\.|od|do\s+roku|do\s+r\.|do|před\s+rokem|před|po\s+roce|po\s+r\.|po"
    r"|kolem\s+roku|kolem|kol\.|okolo|asi\s+v\s+roce|asi|cca\.?|přibližně|snad"
    r"|v\s+letech|mezi\s+lety|v\s+roce|v\s+r\.|roku|r\.|již\s+v\s+roce|již|už)\s+"
    rf"{_DAY_MONTH}(?P<y1>{_Y})(?:(?:{_DASH}|\s+(?:do|až|a)\s+){_DAY_MONTH}(?P<y2>{_Y}))?",
    re.I)
_WORD_FORM = [(r"od\b", "from"), (r"do\b", "until"), (r"před\b", "before"), (r"po\b", "after"),
              (r"kol\b|kolem|okolo|asi|cca|přibližně|snad", "circa"),
              (r"v\s+letech|mezi", "range")]

_RANGE = re.compile(rf"^(?i:dne\s+)?{_DAY_MONTH}(?P<y1>{_Y})(?:{_DASH}{_DAY_MONTH}(?P<y2>{_Y})"
                    r"|-(?P<yy>\d\d)(?![\d.]))")
_SEASON = re.compile(rf"^(?P<y1>{_Y})/(?P<y2>\d{{4}}|\d\d)(?!\d)")
_LIST = re.compile(rf"^(?P<y1>{_Y})(?:(?:\s*,\s*|\s+a\s+|\s+i\s+){_Y})+")
_SINGLE = re.compile(rf"^(?i:dne\s+)?{_DAY_MONTH}(?P<y1>{_Y})")
_ABBREVIATION_FIRST = re.compile(r"^[A-ZÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ]{2,5}\s+(?=\d{4})")

_NO_DATE = {"date_form": None, "date_raw": None, "start_lo": np.nan, "start_hi": np.nan,
            "end_lo": np.nan, "end_hi": np.nan, "century_inferred": False}


def year_span(token: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """``1873`` → (1873, 1873); ``187x`` → (1870, 1879); ``18xx`` → (1800, 1899)."""
    tok = token.strip()
    if tok[-2:].lower() == "xx":
        return int(tok[:2]) * 100, int(tok[:2]) * 100 + 99
    if tok[-1].lower() == "x":
        return int(tok[:3]) * 10, int(tok[:3]) * 10 + 9
    return int(tok), int(tok)


def infer_century(decade: int, context_year) -> int | None:
    """The century of a bare ``80. léta``, from the line above it.

    The chronicle runs forward in time, so the decade is put in the earliest century that
    does not end it before the last dated line: after a 1977 line, ``V 80. letech`` is the
    1980s.  With nothing dated above it there is no reading, and None is returned.
    """
    if context_year is None or pd.isna(context_year):
        return None
    for century in range(1500, 2100, 100):
        if century + decade + 9 >= int(context_year):
            return century
    return None


def _date(form, raw, start=(np.nan, np.nan), end=(np.nan, np.nan), inferred=False) -> dict:
    return {"date_form": form, "date_raw": raw, "start_lo": start[0], "start_hi": start[1],
            "end_lo": end[0], "end_hi": end[1], "century_inferred": inferred}


def _modifier(text: str | None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if not text:
        return "whole", "in"
    for pattern, part, direction in _MODIFIERS:
        if re.fullmatch(pattern, text.strip(), re.I):
            return part, direction
    return "whole", "in"


def _period(m: re.Match, context_year) -> dict:
    """A century or decade phrase (``koncem 80. let 19. stol.``) as start/end intervals."""
    part, direction = _modifier(m.group("mod"))
    inferred = False
    if m.group("c1"):
        bases = [(int(m.group(g)) - 1) * 100 for g in ("c1", "c2") if m.group(g)]
        offsets = _CENTURY_PART[part]
    else:
        decades = [int(m.group(g)) for g in ("d1", "d2") if m.group(g)]
        if m.group("dc"):
            century = (int(m.group("dc")) - 1) * 100
        else:
            century, inferred = infer_century(decades[0], context_year), True
            if century is None:
                return _date("period, no century", m.group(0))
        bases = [century + d for d in decades]
        offsets = _DECADE_PART[part]
    if part == "turn":                     # `19./20. stol.` names one turn, not two units
        bases = bases[:1]
    first = (bases[0] + offsets[0], bases[0] + offsets[1])
    whole = _DECADE_PART["whole"] if m.group("d1") else _CENTURY_PART["whole"]
    last = (bases[-1] + whole[0], bases[-1] + whole[1]) if len(bases) > 1 else None
    if direction == "until":
        return _date("period", m.group(0), end=last or first, inferred=inferred)
    return _date("period", m.group(0), start=first, end=last or (np.nan, np.nan),
                 inferred=inferred)


def _word_year(m: re.Match) -> dict:
    word = m.group("word").lower()
    form = next((f for p, f in _WORD_FORM if re.match(p, word)), "year")
    y1 = year_span(m.group("y1"))
    y2 = year_span(m.group("y2")) if m.group("y2") else (np.nan, np.nan)
    raw = m.group(0)
    if form == "until":
        return _date("until", raw, end=y1)
    if form == "before":
        return _date("before", raw, start=(np.nan, y1[0] - 1))
    if form == "after":
        return _date("after", raw, start=(y1[0], np.nan))
    if form == "circa":
        return _date("circa", raw, start=(y1[0] - CIRCA_YEARS, y1[1] + CIRCA_YEARS))
    if form == "year" and m.group("y2"):
        form = "range"
    return _date(form, raw, start=y1, end=y2)


def _numeric(line: str) -> dict | None:
    """A line opening with a year: a range, a season, a list or a single year."""
    if (m := _RANGE.match(line)):
        start = year_span(m.group("y1"))
        if m.group("yy"):
            year = start[0] // 100 * 100 + int(m.group("yy"))
            end = (year + 100, year + 100) if year < start[0] else (year, year)
        else:
            end = year_span(m.group("y2"))
        if end[1] < start[0]:              # a later year cannot close an earlier one
            return _date("year", m.group("y1"), start=start)
        return _date("range", m.group(0), start=start, end=end)
    if (m := _SEASON.match(line)):
        start = year_span(m.group("y1"))
        tail = m.group("y2")
        year = int(tail) if len(tail) == 4 else start[0] // 100 * 100 + int(tail)
        return _date("season", m.group(0), start=start, end=(year, year))
    if (m := _LIST.match(line)):
        years = re.findall(_Y, m.group(0))
        return _date("list", m.group(0), start=year_span(years[0]), end=year_span(years[-1]))
    if (m := _SINGLE.match(line)):
        token = m.group("y1")
        form = "century" if token[-2:].lower() == "xx" else "decade" if token[-1] in "xX" else "year"
        return _date(form, m.group(0), start=year_span(token))
    return None


def parse_leading_date(line: str, context_year=None) -> dict:
    """The date a chronicle line opens with, as start/end intervals and a ``date_form``.

    Only the **leading** date is read — a later year inside the line (``1934 22
    představení, 1935 19``) is the line's content, not its date.  Forms: ``year`` /
    ``decade`` / ``century`` (one printed year), ``range``, ``season`` (``1911/12``),
    ``list`` (``1887 a 1912``), ``from``, ``until``, ``before``, ``after``, ``circa``,
    ``period`` (a century or decade phrase), ``era`` (the wars, the First Republic).
    ``context_year`` is the last dated line above, used only to give a bare ``80. léta``
    its century (``century_inferred``).  No date: every field empty, ``date_form`` None.
    """
    text = (line or "").strip()
    for pattern, start, end in _ERA_PATTERNS:
        if (m := pattern.match(text)):
            return _date("era", m.group(0), start=start, end=end or (np.nan, np.nan))
    if (m := _PERIOD.match(text)):
        return _period(m, context_year)
    if (m := _WORD_YEAR.match(text)):
        return _word_year(m)
    if (date := _numeric(text)):
        return date
    # an ensemble's abbreviation before its years: `ŠS 1932 - 1938`, `LS 1928-1929`
    if (m := _ABBREVIATION_FIRST.match(text)) and (date := _numeric(text[m.end():])):
        return date
    return dict(_NO_DATE)


def _is_known(value) -> bool:
    return value is not None and not pd.isna(value)


def attests_before(start_lo, start_hi, end_lo, end_hi, cutoff: int = PRE_WAR_CUTOFF) -> str:
    """Does a dated line put theatre activity before ``cutoff``?  ``yes / no / ambiguous / unknown``.

    With a start: *yes* if it certainly began before the cutoff, *no* if certainly not.
    With only an end (``do 1910``): the activity was going on before that end, so *yes*
    if the end is before the cutoff — otherwise *ambiguous*, never *no*.
    """
    if _is_known(start_lo) or _is_known(start_hi):
        lo = start_lo if _is_known(start_lo) else -np.inf
        hi = start_hi if _is_known(start_hi) else np.inf
        return "yes" if hi < cutoff else "no" if lo >= cutoff else "ambiguous"
    if _is_known(end_hi):
        return "yes" if end_hi < cutoff else "ambiguous"
    return "unknown"


_SEPARATOR = re.compile(r"^[\s\-–—_=*.xX]+$")
_HEADING_START = re.compile(r"^(?:loutkov\w*\s+divadl\w*|historie|zahraniční\s+reprezentace)", re.I)
_CITATION = re.compile(r"^[A-ZÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ][^\d]{1,60}?\s\d{1,2}\.\s*\d{1,2}\.\s*(?P<y>1\d\d\d|20[0-2]\d)"
                       r"\.?(?:,\s*(?:s|č|str)\.\s*[\d\-–]+\.?)?$")
# the okres must be named (a capital), so `okresní přehlídka` is not an admin note
_ADMIN = re.compile(r"^(?i:od|do)\b.{0,40}?\b(?i:okres\w*|okr\.|o\.)\s+[A-ZÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ]"
                    r"|(?i:\bsoučástí\s+okresu\b|\bpatřil\w*\s+do\s+okresu\b)")
# LD loutkové divadlo, LS loutkářský soubor / loutková scéna, Lkr loutkářský kroužek,
# DLS dětský loutkářský soubor — the database's key
_PUPPET = re.compile(r"(?i:\bloutk\w*|\bmaňásk\w*)|\b(?:LD|LS|Lkr|DLS)\b")


def chronicle_line_kind(line: str) -> str | None:
    """``separator`` / ``heading`` / ``citation`` / ``admin``, or None for a note.

    A *citation* is a periodical and a full date and nothing else (``Moravský deník
    13.9.1935.``) — the source of the line above, dated by publication.  *Admin* is the
    database's own note on which okres the place belongs to now (``Od 1. 1. 2007 okres
    Praha-východ``), which opens with a date but is no event.
    """
    text = line.strip()
    if _SEPARATOR.match(text):
        return "separator"
    if not re.search(r"\d", text) and len(text) <= 45 and (
            text.endswith(":") or text.isupper() or _HEADING_START.match(text)):
        return "heading"
    if _CITATION.match(text):
        return "citation"
    if len(text) < 120 and _ADMIN.search(text):
        return "admin"
    return None


CHRONICLE_COLUMNS = ["geo_id", "line_no", "kind", "section", "date_form", "date_raw",
                     "start_lo", "start_hi", "end_lo", "end_hi", "century_inferred",
                     "associations", "ambiguous_abbreviations", "umdoc", "puppet", "text"]


def _anchor_year(date: dict):
    for key in ("start_lo", "start_hi", "end_lo", "end_hi"):
        if not pd.isna(date[key]):
            return date[key]
    return None


def read_chronicle(geo_id: int, text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Every non-blank line of one place's chronicle, classified and dated.

    ``kind`` is ``event`` (a note with a leading date), ``undated`` (a note without one —
    often a continuation of the line above), or one of :func:`chronicle_line_kind`'s.  A
    heading opens a ``section`` (``puppet`` for *Loutkové divadlo*), which holds until the
    next heading.  ``associations`` are the :data:`ASSOCIATION_PATTERNS` labels the line
    names, ``|``-joined, and ``ambiguous_abbreviations`` any of them that rest on an
    abbreviation the key reads two ways (``ČOS``); ``umdoc`` marks a line naming the
    national union of amateur theatres; ``puppet`` marks puppet theatre, by section or by
    the line's words.
    """
    rows, section, context = [], "main", None
    for line_no, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines()):
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        kind = chronicle_line_kind(line)
        date = dict(_NO_DATE) if kind in ("separator", "heading") else parse_leading_date(line, context)
        if kind in ("heading", "separator"):    # a new block starts its own chronology
            context = None
        if kind == "heading":
            section = "puppet" if _PUPPET.search(line) else line.rstrip(":").strip().casefold()
        if kind is None:
            kind = "event" if _anchor_year(date) is not None else "undated"
        if kind == "event":
            context = _anchor_year(date)
        if kind == "citation":
            year = int(_CITATION.match(line).group("y"))
            date = _date("publication", line, start=(year, year))
        notes = kind in ("event", "undated")
        rows.append({"geo_id": geo_id, "line_no": line_no, "kind": kind, "section": section,
                     **date,
                     "associations": "|".join(classify_association(line)) if notes else "",
                     "ambiguous_abbreviations":
                         "|".join(dict.fromkeys(_AMBIGUOUS.findall(line))) if notes else "",
                     "umdoc": notes and bool(_UMDOC.search(line)),
                     "puppet": notes and (section == "puppet" or bool(_PUPPET.search(line))),
                     "text": line})
    return rows


def chronicle_lines(places: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """The chronicle of every place as one table — key ``(geo_id, line_no)``, asserted.

    ``line_no`` is the line's position in the place's ``chronicle_text`` (0-based, blank
    lines counted), so any row leads back to its text.  The events are the rows with
    ``kind == "event"`` (:func:`chronicle_events`).  The text is the database's own and,
    like ``places.csv``, never leaves ``data/``.
    """
    rows = []
    for geo_id, text in zip(places["geo_id"], places["chronicle_text"]):
        if isinstance(text, str):
            rows.extend(read_chronicle(int(geo_id), text))
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=CHRONICLE_COLUMNS)
    assert not out.duplicated(["geo_id", "line_no"]).any(), "chronicle: key not unique"
    out["before_1914"] = [attests_before(*r) for r in
                          out[["start_lo", "start_hi", "end_lo", "end_hi"]].itertuples(index=False)]
    out.loc[out["kind"] != "event", "before_1914"] = "unknown"
    return out


def chronicle_events(lines: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """The dated notes of :func:`chronicle_lines` — the event table."""
    return lines[lines["kind"] == "event"].reset_index(drop=True)


def chronicle_place_summary(places: pd.DataFrame, lines: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Per place: how many chronicle events, how many before 1914, which associations.

    One row per place of ``places`` (key ``geo_id``, asserted).  ``earliest_pre_year`` is
    the lowest known bound of the pre-1914 events; ``associations_pre`` the labels any of
    them names, and ``ambiguous_abbreviation_pre`` says whether any of those rests on an
    abbreviation read two ways, so the labels can be re-read without it.  ``umdoc_pre``:
    a pre-1914 event names the national union of amateur theatres (ÚMDOČ).  Puppet
    theatre is counted apart (``n_pre_puppet``) and left out of the rest, since it is a
    different activity, often of children.
    """
    events = chronicle_events(lines)
    pre = events[(events["before_1914"] == "yes") & ~events["puppet"]]
    bound = pre[["start_lo", "start_hi", "end_lo", "end_hi"]].min(axis=1)
    per_place = pd.DataFrame({
        "n_events": events.groupby("geo_id").size(),
        "n_pre": pre.groupby("geo_id").size(),
        "n_ambiguous": events[events["before_1914"] == "ambiguous"].groupby("geo_id").size(),
        "n_pre_puppet": events[(events["before_1914"] == "yes") & events["puppet"]]
        .groupby("geo_id").size(),
        "earliest_pre_year": bound.groupby(pre["geo_id"]).min(),
        "associations_pre": pre.groupby("geo_id")["associations"].agg(
            lambda s: "|".join(sorted({a for v in s for a in v.split("|") if a}))),
        "ambiguous_abbreviation_pre": pre.groupby("geo_id")["ambiguous_abbreviations"].agg(
            lambda s: bool((s != "").any())),
        "umdoc_pre": pre.groupby("geo_id")["umdoc"].any(),
    })
    out = places[["geo_id"]].merge(per_place, left_on="geo_id", right_index=True,
                                   how="left", validate="1:1")
    counts = ["n_events", "n_pre", "n_ambiguous", "n_pre_puppet"]
    out[counts] = out[counts].fillna(0).astype(int)
    out["associations_pre"] = out["associations_pre"].fillna("")
    flags = ["ambiguous_abbreviation_pre", "umdoc_pre"]
    out[flags] = out[flags].astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    assert len(out) == len(places) and out["geo_id"].is_unique
    return out


def century_inference_check(lines: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    """How often :func:`infer_century` would have been right where the century is printed.

    Takes every decade phrase that names its century (``V 80. letech 19. stol.``), drops
    the century, infers it from the dated line above as a bare one would be, and compares.
    """
    pattern = re.compile(r"(?P<d>\d0)\.?.*?(?:léta|let|letech|létech)\b\s*(?P<c>\d{1,2})\.", re.I)
    # the parser's context: the dated line above, inside the same block (headings and
    # separators start a new one)
    block = lines["kind"].isin(["heading", "separator"]).groupby(lines["geo_id"]).cumsum()
    events = lines.assign(block=block)[lines["kind"] == "event"].copy()
    events["anchor"] = events[["start_lo", "start_hi", "end_lo", "end_hi"]].bfill(axis=1).iloc[:, 0]
    events["previous"] = events.groupby(["geo_id", "block"])["anchor"].shift()
    checked = right = 0
    for raw, inferred, previous in zip(events["date_raw"], events["century_inferred"],
                                       events["previous"]):
        m = pattern.search(raw or "") if not inferred else None
        if m is None or pd.isna(previous):
            continue
        checked += 1
        right += infer_century(int(m.group("d")), previous) == (int(m.group("c")) - 1) * 100
    return {"checked": checked, "right": right, "share_right": round(right / max(checked, 1), 3)}


def chronicle_report(places: pd.DataFrame, lines: pd.DataFrame, ensembles: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """Print what the chronicle parser found: kinds, date forms, the pre-1914 yield."""
    events = chronicle_events(lines)
    summary = chronicle_place_summary(places, lines)
    dates = place_dates(places, ensembles)
    print("\n── chronicle lines by kind\n" + lines["kind"].value_counts().to_string())
    print("\n── events by date form\n" + events["date_form"].value_counts().to_string())
    print(f"\n── century of a bare decade inferred on {int(events['century_inferred'].sum()):,} events;"
          f" check where it is printed: {century_inference_check(lines)}")
    print("\n── events: activity before 1914?\n" + events["before_1914"].value_counts().to_string())
    has_pre = summary.set_index("geo_id")["n_pre"] > 0
    no_ensemble = ~dates.set_index("geo_id")["ensemble_pre"]
    print(f"\nplaces with a pre-1914 (non-puppet) chronicle event: {int(has_pre.sum()):,}"
          f" — of them with no ensemble certainly before 1914: {int((has_pre & no_ensemble).sum()):,}")
    pre = events[(events["before_1914"] == "yes") & ~events["puppet"]]
    labels = pre["associations"].str.split("|").explode()
    print("\n── pre-1914 events by association named (an event can name several)\n"
          + labels[labels != ""].value_counts().to_string()
          + f"\nnaming none: {int((pre['associations'] == '').sum()):,} of {len(pre):,}")
    print(f"pre-1914 events resting on an abbreviation read two ways (ČOS):"
          f" {int((pre['ambiguous_abbreviations'] != '').sum()):,};"
          f" naming ÚMDOČ: {int(pre['umdoc'].sum()):,}"
          f" (places: {int(summary['umdoc_pre'].sum()):,})")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clauses — one line is often several events (0.4.0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# `1887-1934 SDO, 1914 32 členů.` is a company's span and a membership count a year
# apart; `1908 DS Sokol Na prahu života, 1930 Teta Fany` two performances 22 years apart.
# A line is cut wherever a new *date* opens after a comma, a semicolon or a full stop —
# and only there, so a clause always starts with its date or is the line's first.  Never
# cut: inside brackets or a quoted title; inside the line's own leading date (`1887, 1888
# a 1890 hráli`); a *report* — a line opening with a full day-and-month date or with
# `YEAR -`, or ending in a periodical citation — which is one dated newspaper extract and
# whose later dates (`bude opakována 23.2.1913`) are its content.  A trailing citation is
# set aside (`citation`), never read as the event's date (D-140).
_CLAUSE_BOUNDARY = re.compile(r"(?:[,;]|\.(?=\s))\s+")
# a word that may stand before the new clause's date: `…her. Poté do 1937 56 her.`
_CLAUSE_LEAD = re.compile(r"^(?:poté|pak|potom|později|znovu|opět|též|také|ale|však|dále"
                          r"|naposled|naposledy|zejména|hlavně)\s+", re.I)


def _after_lead(piece: str) -> str:
    return piece[m.end():] if (m := _CLAUSE_LEAD.match(piece)) else piece
# words a full stop ends without ending the sentence — `zal. 1895`, `r. 1890`, `19. stol.`
_ABBREVIATION_WORDS = {
    "r", "zal", "stol", "st", "sv", "svět", "č", "s", "str", "kol", "cca", "tzv", "tj",
    "např", "ad", "uč", "řed", "p", "pp", "ev", "hl", "div", "spol", "ochot", "odb", "nar",
    "zem", "obnov", "přejm", "zah", "zan", "ust", "pol", "zač", "poč", "resp", "aj", "atd", "mj", "srv", "viz",
    "inf", "ing", "mudr", "judr", "phdr", "dr", "prof", "mgr", "fr", "jos", "ant", "jan"}
_QUOTED = re.compile(r'"[^"]*"|“[^”“]*[”“]|„[^“”]*[“”]|»[^«]*«|«[^»]*»')
_TRAILING_CITATION = re.compile(
    r"(?:\s*\((?:Informac\w*|Inf\.)[^)]*\)\.?"
    r"|\s*Inf\.\s*ex:.*"
    r"|\s+[A-ZÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ][\w.]*(?:\s+[\w.]+){0,5}\s+\d{1,2}\.\s*\d{1,2}\.\s*1\d\d\d\.?)\s*$")
_FULL_DATE_LEAD = re.compile(rf"^(?i:dne\s+)?\d{{1,2}}\.\s*(?:\d{{1,2}}\.|{_MONTHS})\s*1\d\d\d")
_DASH_LEAD = re.compile(rf"^(?:{_Y}|{_DAY_MONTH}{_Y})\s*[-–—]\s*(?=[^\d\s])")
# a year, not the tail of a number; but the year of a full date written tight, `8.2.1903`,
# is one (D-254, rare case 90)
_YEAR_TOKEN = re.compile(rf"(?:(?<![\d.])|(?<=\d\.)){_Y}")

CLAUSE_COLUMNS = ["geo_id", "line_no", "clause_no", "line_kind", "section", "report",
                  "date_source", "date_form", "date_raw", "start_lo", "start_hi", "end_lo",
                  "end_hi", "century_inferred", "years_listed", "years_inside", "date_only",
                  "associations", "ambiguous_abbreviations", "puppet", "cues", "citation", "text"]


def _protected_spans(text: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Character spans a clause boundary may not fall in: brackets (nested) and quotes."""
    spans, depth, opened = [], 0, 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(text):
        if ch == "(":
            if depth == 0:
                opened = i
            depth += 1
        elif ch == ")" and depth:
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                spans.append((opened, i + 1))
    if depth:                                   # an unclosed bracket runs to the end
        spans.append((opened, len(text)))
    spans += [m.span() for m in _QUOTED.finditer(text)]
    return spans


def is_report(line: str) -> bool:
    """A dated newspaper extract, read as one event: never cut into clauses."""
    text = (line or "").strip()
    return bool(_FULL_DATE_LEAD.match(text) or _DASH_LEAD.match(text)
                or _TRAILING_CITATION.search(text))


def _ends_abbreviation(text: str, stop: int) -> bool:
    """Does the full stop at ``stop`` close an abbreviation or an ordinal rather than a sentence?"""
    word = re.search(r"(\w+)$", text[:stop])
    if word is None:
        return False
    token = word.group(1)
    return (token.casefold() in _ABBREVIATION_WORDS or len(token) == 1
            or (token.isdigit() and len(token) <= 2))


def clause_cuts(line: str, context_year=None) -> list[int]:
    """Character offsets at which a line is cut into clauses (the first, 0, included)."""
    text = line or ""
    cuts = [0]
    if is_report(text):
        return cuts
    lead = parse_leading_date(text.strip(), context_year)
    lead_end = text.find(lead["date_raw"]) + len(lead["date_raw"]) if lead["date_raw"] else 0
    spans = _protected_spans(text)
    for m in _CLAUSE_BOUNDARY.finditer(text):
        at = m.end()
        if at <= lead_end or any(a <= m.start() < b for a, b in spans):
            continue
        if text[m.start()] == "." and _ends_abbreviation(text, m.start()):
            continue
        if parse_leading_date(_after_lead(text[at:]), context_year)["date_form"] is not None:
            cuts.append(at)
    return cuts


def split_clauses(line: str, line_date: dict | None = None, context_year=None) -> list[dict]:
    """One chronicle line as its dated clauses.

    The first clause carries the line's own date (``line_date``, the dict
    :func:`parse_leading_date` returns — ``date_source = "line"``, or ``"none"`` for an
    undated line); every later one starts with its own (``"own"``), and a bare decade in it
    takes its century from the clause before.  ``years_inside`` lists every other year the
    clause prints (``zanikl 1931``, a bracketed `zal. 1895`), ``years_listed`` the years of
    a leading list (``1910 a 1913`` — two years, not a span), ``date_only`` marks a clause
    that is nothing but its date (``…, 1907, 1910`` — the activity of the clause before,
    again).  A trailing periodical citation is moved to ``citation``.
    """
    text = (line or "").strip()
    report, citation = is_report(text), ""
    if (m := _TRAILING_CITATION.search(text)) and m.start() > 0:
        citation, text = m.group(0).strip(), text[:m.start()].rstrip()
    first = dict(line_date) if line_date is not None else parse_leading_date(text, context_year)
    cuts = [0] if report else clause_cuts(text, context_year)
    clauses, context = [], _anchor_year(first) if first["date_form"] else context_year
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(cuts, cuts[1:] + [len(text)])):
        piece = re.sub(r"[\s,;]+$", "", text[a:b]).strip()
        if i == 0:
            date, source = first, "line" if _anchor_year(first) is not None else "none"
        else:
            date, source = parse_leading_date(_after_lead(piece), context), "own"
            context = _anchor_year(date) if _anchor_year(date) is not None else context
        raw = date["date_raw"] or ""
        rest = piece[piece.find(raw) + len(raw):] if raw and raw in piece else piece
        listed = _YEAR_TOKEN.findall(raw) if date["date_form"] == "list" else []
        clauses.append({
            "clause_no": i, "date_source": source, **date,
            "years_listed": "|".join(listed),
            "years_inside": "|".join(_YEAR_TOKEN.findall(rest)),
            "date_only": bool(raw) and not re.search(r"\w", rest),
            "citation": citation if i == len(cuts) - 1 else "",
            "text": piece})
    return clauses


def chronicle_clauses(lines: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Every event and undated note of :func:`chronicle_lines` cut into dated clauses.

    Key ``(geo_id, line_no, clause_no)``, asserted; every line yields at least one clause
    and the clauses of a line, joined, give back its text less the trailing citation.  The
    first clause keeps the line's date exactly as :func:`chronicle_lines` read it.
    ``report`` marks a line kept whole (:func:`is_report`).  ``associations`` and
    ``puppet`` are the clause's own (a puppet section makes every clause in it puppet);
    the line's are in ``chronicle_lines``.  ``cues`` are :func:`event_cues`, not codes.
    """
    notes = lines[lines["kind"].isin(["event", "undated"])]
    date_cols = ["date_form", "date_raw", "start_lo", "start_hi", "end_lo", "end_hi",
                 "century_inferred"]
    rows = []
    for r in notes.itertuples(index=False):
        line_date = {c: getattr(r, c) for c in date_cols}
        line_date["date_raw"] = line_date["date_raw"] if isinstance(line_date["date_raw"], str) else None
        line_date["date_form"] = line_date["date_form"] if isinstance(line_date["date_form"], str) else None
        context = _anchor_year(line_date) if line_date["date_form"] else None
        report = is_report(r.text)
        for clause in split_clauses(r.text, line_date, context):
            rows.append({
                "geo_id": r.geo_id, "line_no": r.line_no, "line_kind": r.kind,
                "section": r.section, "report": report, **clause,
                "associations": "|".join(classify_association(clause["text"])),
                "ambiguous_abbreviations": "|".join(dict.fromkeys(_AMBIGUOUS.findall(clause["text"]))),
                "puppet": r.section == "puppet" or bool(_PUPPET.search(clause["text"])),
                "cues": "|".join(event_cues(clause["text"], clause["date_raw"]))})
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=CLAUSE_COLUMNS)
    assert not out.duplicated(["geo_id", "line_no", "clause_no"]).any(), "clauses: key not unique"
    assert out[["geo_id", "line_no"]].drop_duplicates().shape[0] == len(notes), "clauses: a line lost"
    out["before_1914"] = [attests_before(*r) for r in
                          out[["start_lo", "start_hi", "end_lo", "end_hi"]].itertuples(index=False)]
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event cues — the codebook's draft, before the author rules on it
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One pattern per codebook type, word-anchored on the stem.  A *cue* is not a code: it says
# the clause uses a word the type is written in, so the codebook page can show how often
# each type would come up and what it would catch.  Types are not exclusive (`1895 zal.
# SDO, hrál v hostinci` is a founding, activity and a venue).  Which of them enter the
# measure, and how, is the author's ruling (codebook page); the model pass reads the
# clauses the cues leave open.
EVENT_CUES: dict[str, re.Pattern] = {
    "founded": re.compile(
        r"\bzal\.|\bzaložen\w*|\bzaložil\w*|\bvznik\w*|\bustaven\w*|\bustavil\w*"
        r"|\butvořil\w*|\bzřízen\w*", re.I),
    "statutes": re.compile(r"\bstanov\w*|\bregistr\w*", re.I),
    "permit": re.compile(r"\bpovol\w*|\blicenc\w*|\bkoncese\w*", re.I),
    "active": re.compile(
        r"\bhrál\w*|\bhrálo\b|\bhrával\w*|\bhrán[oay]?\b|\bhraj[eí]\b|\bhrají\b|\bčinn\w*|\bpůsobil\w*|\bpůsobí\b|\bpořádal\w*"
        r"|\b(?:začal\w*|začalo|začín\w*|počal\w*|mohl\w*|směl\w*)\s+(?:\w+\s+){0,2}?hrát\b|\bvystoupen\w*"
        r"|\bprovozoval\w*|\baktivn\w*|\bzaznamenán\w*|\bdolož\w*", re.I),
    "performance": re.compile(
        r"\bsehrál\w*|\bsehrán\w*|\bsehraj\w*|\buvedl\w*|\buveden\w*|\bprovedl\w*|\bproveden\w*"
        r"|\bpředstavení\b|\bdávali\b|\bdáván\w*|\bveselohr\w*|\bfrašk\w*|\bčinohr\w*|\boperet\w*"
        r"|\bzpěvohr\w*|\bpremiér\w*|\bhru\b|\bhra\b|\bscénk\w*|\buv\.", re.I),
    "title": re.compile(r'"[^"]{2,}"|“[^”“]{2,}[”“]|„[^“”]{2,}[“”]'),
    "count": re.compile(
        r"\b\d+\s*(?:her|hry|představení|premiér\w*|inscenac\w*|činoher|operet|kusů|kusy)\b"
        r"|\b\d{1,2}\s*[x×]\b", re.I),             # `3x`, not the decade `188x`
    "attendance": re.compile(
        r"\bnávštěv\w*|\bdivák\w*|\bobecenstv\w*|\bposluchač\w*|\bvyprodán\w*"
        r"|\bpro\s+\d+\s*(?:osob|lidí|diváků)|\b\d+\s*(?:diváků|osob)\b", re.I),
    "proceeds": re.compile(r"\bve\s+prospěch\b|\bvýtěž\w*|\bvýnos\w*|\bna\s+fond\w*", re.I),
    "national_theatre": re.compile(
        r"\bnárodní\w*\s+divadl\w*|\bdivadla\s+národního\b|\bND\b", re.I),
    "venue": re.compile(
        r"\bhostin\w*|\bhospod(?!ář)\w*|\bsál\w*|\bradnic\w*|\bzám(?:ek|ku|ecké\w*)\b|\bsokolovn\w*"
        r"|\bv\s+přírodě\b|\bletní\s+(?:scén|divadl)\w*|\bjevišt\w*|\bdekorac\w*|\bopon\w*", re.I),
    "building": re.compile(r"\bpostav\w*|\bstavb\w*|\bvyhoř\w*|\bpožár\w*|\bbudov\w*", re.I),
    # played in German, or a German theatre noun — not a place name (`Německý Brod`) nor
    # `německý národnostní tlak` (0.5.0, D-141)
    "german": re.compile(
        r"\bněmecky\b|\bněmčin\w*|\bdeutsch\w*|\bněmeck\w*\s+(?:ochotnick\w*|divadl\w*"
        r"|představení|hr[auy]\b|spol\w*|jednot\w*|OS\b|nadšenc\w*)|\bspol(?:ek|ku)\s+(?:\w+\s+)?německ\w*", re.I),
    "latin": re.compile(r"\blatin\w*|\blatinsk\w*", re.I),
    "first": re.compile(r"\bpoprvé\b|\bprvní\s+(?:představení|hr[auy]|divadel\w*|zpráv\w*|doklad\w*"
                        r"|zmín\w*|česk\w*)", re.I),
    "travelling": re.compile(r"\bkočovn\w*|\bhereck\w+\s+společnost\w*|\bdivadeln\w+\s+společnost\w*"
                             r"|\bspolečnost\w*\s+(?:[A-ZČŘŠŽ]\.\s*)?[A-ZČŘŠŽ]\w+(?:ov[aýy]|ého)\b"),
    # who played, not who organised or where (D-254, rare case 121): pupils, students, a
    # school's own stage, clergy — not a parish priest who started the amateurs, nor a play
    # given in a school building (`hráli ve škole`)
    "school_church": re.compile(r"\bstudent\w*|\bstudují\w*|\bžác\w*|\bžák\w*|\bškolák\w*|\bakademi[kc]\w*"
                                r"|\bškolní\w*\s+(?:dětsk\w+\s+)?(?:mládež\w*|děti|dít\w*|divadl\w*|div\.|soubor\w*"
                                r"|představení|hr[auy]\b|slavnost\w*)"
                                r"|\bškol\w+\s+(?:dět\w*|dítk\w*|hoš\w*|mládež\w*)|\bškolsk\w+\s+(?:hr\w*|divadl\w*|soubor\w*)"
                                r"|\bsoubor\w*\s+(?:\w+\s+)?škol\w*|\bdět\w*\s+(?:z\s+)?(?:místní\s+)?škol\w*"
                                r"|\bdivadl\w*\s+(?:místní\s+|zdejší\s+)?škol\w*|\bgymn\w*"
                                r"|\bjezuit\w*|\bpiarist\w*|\bklášter\w*|\bseminar\w*|\baugustin(?:ián|ian)\w*|\bkapucín\w*"
                                r"|\bfrantiškán\w*|\bbenediktin\w*|\bpremonstrát\w*|\bcisterci\w*|\bminorit\w*"
                                r"|\bdominikán\w*|\břeholn\w*|\bmnich(?!ov)\w*|\bmniš\w*", re.I),
    "ban": re.compile(r"\bzakáz\w*|\bzákaz\w*|\bnepovol\w*|\bzamítn\w*|\bcenzur\w*|\bkonfisk\w*"
                      r"|\brozpušt\w*|\bzastaven\w*", re.I),
    # a decline is not a pause (D-254 Q11): `útlum` is activity going on at a lower level
    "pause": re.compile(r"\bpřeruš\w*|\bpauz\w*|\bnehrál\w*|\bnečinn\w*|\bnepracoval\w*", re.I),
    "decline": re.compile(r"\bútlum\w*|\bochab\w*|\bstagn\w*|\búpad\w*|\bupadal\w*|\bslábl\w*"
                          r"|\bslábnout\w*|\bopadl\w*", re.I),
    "ended": re.compile(r"\bzanik\w*|\bzánik\w*|\bukončen\w*|\brozešel\b|\brozpadl\w*|\bzrušen\w*"
                        r"|\blikvid\w*|\bskončil\w*", re.I),
    "renamed": re.compile(r"\bpřejmenov\w*|\bnázv\w*|\bnázev\b|\bpřeměnil\w*|\bsloučen\w*"
                          r"|\bsplynul\w*|\bpřevzal\w*|\bpřešel\b", re.I),
    # a cast list is the members (D-254, rare case 3): `Kryšpína hrál Václav Kadlec`, `Účinkovali: …`
    "members": re.compile(r"\b\d+\s*člen\w*|\bčlenem\b|\bčlenové\b|\bčlenů\b|\bčlenstv\w*|\bÚMDOČ\b"
                          r"|\bobsazení\b|\búčinkoval\w*"
                          r"|(?-i:\bhrál[aiy]?\s+(?:[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ]\.\s*)?[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ][a-záčďéěíňóřšťúůýž]+\s+"
                          r"(?:[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ][a-záčďéěíňóřšťúůýž]+|[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ]\.))", re.I),
    # D-254 Q5: a dated note of a company's life that records no play — on its own page an act
    # of the company (its meeting, its records, an evening it held, its jubilee, a venture
    # it co-founded, a member at an umbrella body's meeting); on a place's chronicle coded only
    "company_note": re.compile(
        r"\bvaln\w*\s+hromad\w*|\bschůz\w*|\barchiv\w*|\bkronik\w*|\bvýročí\b|\bjubil\w*|\boslav\w*"
        r"|\bzábav\w*|\bvěneč\w*|\bples\w*|\bakademi(?:e|i|í|ích)\b|\bbesed(?:a|u|ou|y)\b|\bkoncert\w*"
        r"|\bvýlet\w*|\bsjezd\w*|\busnes\w*|\bspoluzaklad\w*|\bčestn\w*\s+člen\w*|\bustavující\w*", re.I),
    # D-221: the company's officers named or elected — chairman, secretary, treasurer, its
    # director or a stage director (`r. Jaroslav Mareš`); not a school's or a town's
    "officers": re.compile(
        r"\b(?:místo)?předsed\w*|\bjednatel\w*|\bpokladní\w*|\bvýbor(?:u|em|ech|y|ů)?\b|\brežisér\w*|\brežírova\w*"
        r"|\brežii\b|\brežie\b|\bdivadeln\w+\s+ředitel\w*|\břediteli?\s+(?:spolku|ochotník\w*|divadla|souboru)\b"
        r"|(?<![\w.])r\.\s+(?:[A-ZČŘŠŽ]\.\s*)?[A-ZČŘŠŽ][a-záčďéěíňóřšťúůýž]+"),
    "hedged": re.compile(r"\bpatrně\b|\bsnad\b|\bzřejmě\b|\búdajně\b|\bprý\b|\bmožná\b"
                         r"|\bpravděpodobně\b|\?", re.I),
}


# `1851-1893 Thalia.`, `Od 1885 jako SDO Tyl.` — a date and a company's name and nothing
# else: the chronicle's commonest form, a company listed as active.  Read structurally:
# no other cue, and at most this many words after the date.
LISTED_MAX_WORDS = 8
LISTED_MAY_NAME = {"officers", "members"}
# `1904 Jindřich Vilhelm: Mistr Bedrník a jeho chasa.`, `1901 - 10. 11. - V. L. Moser: Na
# Dušičky.` — a date, an author and a play: a repertoire entry, so a performance with its title,
# not a company listed (audit 2026-11-11 A3; 2,536 of 5,677 pre-1914 `listed` clauses on the
# companies' pages).  The author is a name (a capital) of at most AUTHOR_MAX_WORDS words — a
# longer run before the colon is a sentence (`vyšla v Div. listech stať V. Štecha: …`, a cast
# list, a festival's societies; found on a 176-clause sample, D-223) — and the title follows.
AUTHOR_MAX_WORDS = 6
_AUTHOR_TITLE = re.compile(
    r"^[\s\-–—,.]*(?:[/\-–]\d{1,2}(?![\d.])\s*[\-–—]?\s*)?(?:\d{1,2}\.\s*\d{1,2}\.\s*[\-–—]?\s*)?"
    r"(?P<author>[^:;\"„“”()]*?[A-ZČŘŠŽÚÁÉÍĎŤŇ][^:;\"„“”()]{0,60}?)\s*:\s*(?P<title>[^\s:].*)$")


#: Words that head a colon without naming an author (`Hudba: Josef Novák`, `Režie: J. Novák`,
#: `Účinkovali: …`, `Výtěžek: 20 zl.`): a one-word "author" that is one of them is no play
#: (review of D-224).  A translator before a name (`přel. J. J. Kolár:`) is still an author.
LABEL_WORDS = {"hudba", "hudbu", "režie", "režii", "režisér", "režisérka", "režiséři", "účinkovali", "účinkují",
               "hráli", "hrají", "obsazení", "role", "pozn", "poznámka", "výtěžek", "vstupné", "kp",
               "text", "libreto", "dekorace", "kostýmy", "zpěvy", "sbor", "dirigent", "nápověda",
               "program", "repertoár", "pořad", "inscenace", "premiéra", "reprízy", "scéna",
               # officers and meetings (second review of D-224: `Předseda: Jan Novák`)
               "předseda", "místopředseda", "jednatel", "pokladník", "pokladní", "ředitel", "zapisovatel",
               "výbor", "hromada", "schůze"}


def _is_author(author: str) -> bool:
    """A name: at most :data:`AUTHOR_MAX_WORDS` words, no digit, ending on a capitalised word
    or an initial (`J. K. Tyl`, `V. L. M.`, `přel. J. J. Kolár`), and that last word not a
    label (`Režiséři:`, `Předseda:`).  `malíř Neureiter z Prahy namaloval dekorace:` or
    `Inf. o průběhu valné hromady:` end on a common word and are sentences, not authors
    (second review of D-224)."""
    words = re.findall(r"\w+", author)
    if not 0 < len(words) <= AUTHOR_MAX_WORDS or re.search(r"\d", author):
        return False
    last = words[-1]
    return last[0].isupper() and last.casefold() not in LABEL_WORDS


def _repertoire_entry(rest: str):
    """The :data:`_AUTHOR_TITLE` match of a clause's text after its date, or None."""
    m = _AUTHOR_TITLE.match(rest)
    return m if m and _is_author(m.group("author")) else None


# One play of a repertoire line: from the last separator (`,` `;` ` - ` or the start), an
# optional day-month, then a name of at most AUTHOR_MAX_WORDS words with a capital, a colon
# and the title.  `Alois Mrštík, Vilém Mrštík: Maryša` is one play (the first name has no
# colon); `… Tyl: Bankrotář; 12. 3. Tyl: Pražský flamendr` is two.
_PLAY = re.compile(
    r"(?:^|[,;]|\s[-–—]\s)\s*[-–—]?\s*(?:\d{1,2}\.\s*\d{1,2}\.\s*(?:1[5-9]\d\d)?\s*[-–—]?\s*)?"
    r"(?P<author>[^,;:()\"„“”\d/][^,;:()\"„“”]{0,80}?)\s*:\s*(?=[^\s:])")
# where a play's title stops: a genre word, a director or translator, a benefit, a sentence
_TITLE_END = re.compile(
    r"[(;]|,\s*(?:aneb\b)?\s*(?=(?:r\.|režie|přel|překl|hráno|opakov|ve\s+prospěch|výt[ěe]ž|veselohr|činohr"
    r"|truchlohr|fraš|drama|obraz|opere|aktov|jednoaktov|lidová|divadelní|hra\b|zpěvohr|komedi))"
    r"|,\s*(?=[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ]\.\s)|\s+(?:ad|aj|atd)\.|\.\s|\.$|[\"„“”]", re.I)


# where a repertoire line passes to another stretch: plays after it are not the clause's year's
# (`… ; v následujících letech Stroupežnický: …`, `… do roku 1914 …`; review of D-224)
_OTHER_STRETCH = re.compile(
    r"\bv\s+(?:dalších|následujících|příštích|pozdějších)\s+letech"
    r"|\b(?:následující|příští|další|minul|předchozí)\w*\s+(?:rok|roku|roce|letech|sezon\w*)"
    r"|\bv\s+roce\s+následující\w*|\bpozději\b|\bdo\s+roku\s+\d{4}|\bdo\s+konce\b", re.I)
# a programme item that is not a play: a song, a poem, a recitation, music (`A. Javůrek: Klepny,
# komický trojzpěv`); `zpěvohra` and a play `se zpěvy` are theatre and stay
_NOT_A_PLAY = re.compile(r"\b(?:troj|dvoj|čtvero)?zpěv\b|\b\w*(?:troj|dvoj)zpěv\w*|\bkuplet\w*|\bpíse[ňn]\b|\bpísn(?:ě|í|ích|ěmi)\b"
                         r"|\bbáse[ňn]\w*|\bdeklam\w*|\brecitac\w*|\bouvertur\w*|\bkoncert\w*", re.I)
# a repertoire planned, not staged (second review of D-224: `1909 - plánováno na jaro - Tréval: …`)
_PLANNED = re.compile(r"\bplánov\w*|\bzamýšl\w*|\bchystal\w*|\bchystan\w*|\bpřipravoval\w*|\bnenastudov\w*", re.I)
# a co-author or an authorless play left on the end of the previous title by the next play's
# start, which stops at a comma (`Zasvěcenec, Oskar Blumenthal, překlad B. Prusík: Dvéře …`)
_TRAILING_NAMES = re.compile(r",\s*(?:[A-ZČŘŠŽÚÁÉÍĎŤŇ][\w.]*\s*){1,4}$")


def _repertoire_titles(rest: str, year: int | None = None, whole: bool = False) -> list[tuple[str, int, int]]:
    """The plays of a repertoire line as ``(title as printed, start, end)`` in ``rest``.

    Each colon whose name before it (back to the last separator) is an author
    (:func:`_is_author`) starts a play; its title runs to the next play's start, less a
    trailing run of names (:data:`_TRAILING_NAMES`), cut at :data:`_TITLE_END`.  Only the
    plays of the clause's own stretch: the line is read up to the first sign of another
    (:data:`_OTHER_STRETCH`, or a printed year other than ``year``) — unless ``whole``,
    which reads every play the line names (where its words are titles, not cues).  Empty
    unless the line opens as a repertoire entry (:func:`_repertoire_entry`)."""
    if not _repertoire_entry(rest):
        return []
    own = rest
    if not whole:
        cuts = [m.start() for m in [_OTHER_STRETCH.search(rest)] if m]
        cuts += [m.start() for m in re.finditer(_YEAR4, rest) if year is None or int(m.group(1)) != year]
        own = rest[:min(cuts)] if cuts else rest
    # every colon start ends the title before it; only an author's starts a play (a label's,
    # `Hudba: Josef Novák`, or a sentence's does not)
    starts = list(_PLAY.finditer(own))
    titles = []
    for k, m in enumerate(starts):
        if not _is_author(m.group("author")):
            continue
        stop = starts[k + 1].start() if k + 1 < len(starts) else len(own)
        segment = own[m.end():stop]
        if _NOT_A_PLAY.search(segment):
            continue                          # a song or a poem on the programme, not a play
        # the title is a prefix of the segment: the trailing names and the end are cut off its end
        title = _TITLE_END.split(_TRAILING_NAMES.sub("", segment.rstrip(" ,.;")))[0]
        if title.strip(" .,-–—"):
            titles.append((title, m.end(), m.end() + len(title)))
    return titles


def repertoire_plays(rest: str, year: int | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """The play titles of a repertoire line, as :func:`_title_key` keys, one per play
    (:func:`_repertoire_titles`, the clause's own stretch)."""
    return [_title_key(title) for title, _, _ in _repertoire_titles(rest, year)]


def _rest(text: str, date_raw) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """The clause's text after its leading date, and where it starts in ``text``."""
    if isinstance(date_raw, str) and date_raw and date_raw in text:
        at = text.find(date_raw) + len(date_raw)
        return text[at:], at
    return text, 0


def title_spans(text: str, date_raw=None) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Where a clause names a play: its quoted titles and a repertoire line's titles, as
    character spans of ``text``.  Words there are the title's, not the clause's."""
    # a quotation longer than a title (reported speech, a press extract) keeps its words
    spans = [m.span() for m in _QUOTED.finditer(text) if 2 <= len(m.group(0)) - 2 <= 80]
    rest, at = _rest(text, date_raw)
    for title, a, b in _repertoire_titles(rest, whole=True):
        # a title stops at a spaced dash, or at a comma before a lowercase word that is no
        # title's continuation (`aneb`, `čili`): what follows describes the play (`, hráno v sále`)
        stop = _TITLE_TAIL.search(title)
        spans.append((at + a, at + a + (stop.start() if stop else len(title))))
    return spans


_TITLE_TAIL = re.compile(r"\s[-–—]\s|,\s+(?!aneb\b|čili\b|neb\b|a\b)(?=[a-záčďéěíňóřšťúůýž])")


def mask_titles(text: str, date_raw=None) -> str:
    """``text`` with its play titles (:func:`title_spans`) blanked, offsets kept: a venue word
    inside `Paní hostinská` or a ban inside `Zakázané ovoce` is no cue (D-254, rare case 7)."""
    chars = list(text)
    for a, b in title_spans(text, date_raw):
        chars[a:b] = " " * (b - a)
    return "".join(chars)


# D-254 Q12: a hedge counts only where it qualifies whether or when the theatre event
# happened — not a detail: an ordinal (`35.(?) výročí`), an author (`Jan Ladecký (patrně)`,
# `zřejmě i autor`), a later event after the dated one (`1882 … začíná hrát, později se zřejmě
# začlenil`), nor a question mark inside a play's title (masked, :func:`mask_titles`)
_HEDGE_ORDINAL = re.compile(r"\d+\.\s*\(?\s*$")
_HEDGE_AFTER_NAME = re.compile(r"[A-ZČŘŠŽÚÁÉÍĎŤŇ][\w.]*\s*\(\s*$")
_HEDGE_ON_DETAIL = re.compile(r"\s*\)?\s*(?:i\s+|také\s+)?(?:autor\w*|překlad\w*|přel\w*|režisér\w*|skladatel\w*"
                              r"|výročí|jubile\w*|letopoč\w*|první\w*|poprvé|nejstarší\w*)", re.I)
# a question mark on a name inside brackets with no year — an author guessed (`Niobe (Paulton? Nioba, Blumenthal?)`)
_HEDGE_IN_NAME_BRACKET = re.compile(r"\((?:[^()\d]*?)[A-ZČŘŠŽÚÁÉÍĎŤŇ][\w.]*\s*$")
_LATER_EVENT = re.compile(r"\b(?:později|poté|potom|následně|pak|posléze)\b", re.I)
_THEATRE_WORD = re.compile(r"\bdivadl\w*|\bhrá\w*|\bhrál\w*|\bochotn\w*|\bpředstav\w*|\bsehrál\w*|\buvedl\w*", re.I)


def hedge_applies(text, date_raw=None) -> bool:
    """Does the clause hedge its own theatre event (B4 as D-254 Q12 scopes it)?"""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return False
    masked = mask_titles(text, date_raw)
    later = _LATER_EVENT.search(masked) if isinstance(date_raw, str) and date_raw else None
    # a later event's hedge leaves the dated one standing only if the dated part is theatre
    lead_is_theatre = bool(later and _THEATRE_WORD.search(masked[:later.start()]))
    rest, _ = _rest(text, date_raw)
    bare = len(re.findall(r"\w+", rest)) <= LISTED_MAX_WORDS
    for m in EVENT_CUES["hedged"].finditer(masked):
        before, after = masked[:m.start()], masked[m.end():]
        if _HEDGE_ORDINAL.search(before) or _HEDGE_ON_DETAIL.match(after) \
                or (not bare and _HEDGE_AFTER_NAME.search(before)) \
                or (m.group(0) == "?" and not bare and _HEDGE_IN_NAME_BRACKET.search(before)):
            continue
        if later and m.start() > later.start() and lead_is_theatre:
            continue                           # a later event's hedge; the dated one stands
        return True
    return False


_PERFORMANCE_VERB = re.compile(r"\bsehrál\w*|\bsehrán\w*|\bsehraj\w*|\buvedl\w*|\buveden\w*|\bprovedl\w*"
                               r"|\bproveden\w*|\bdávali\b|\bdáván\w*", re.I)
_VAGUE_PLURAL = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:mnoh[aáéoýí]\w*|několik\w*|řad[au]|četn\w*|více)\s+(?:\w+\s+){0,2}?(?:her|hry|představení|kus\w*|činoher|operet\w*)\b"
    r"|\b(?:vícekrát|často|pravidelně)\b(?=(?:\W+\w+){0,3}?\W+(?:hrál\w*|hrálo|hráno|představení|her|hry|pořádal\w*))"
    r"|\b(?:hrál\w*|hrálo|hráno|pořádal\w*)(?:\W+\w+){0,3}?\W+(?:vícekrát|často|pravidelně)\b", re.I)
# a particular play or evening: a day and month, an `Author: Title`, `hru` and a capitalised name
_PARTICULAR_PLAY = re.compile(r"\b\d{1,2}\.\s*\d{1,2}\.|\b(?:hru|činohru|veselohru|frašku|operetu|hra)\s+[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ]")


_CAST_LIST = re.compile(r"(?-i:\bhrál[aiy]?\s+(?:[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ]\.\s*)?[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ][a-záčďéěíňóřšťúůýž]+\s+"
                        r"(?:[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ][a-záčďéěíňóřšťúůýž]+|[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ]\.))")


# a pointer to a list kept elsewhere records nothing (D-254, rare case 108):
# `Přehled všech inscenací … viz níže Příloha`
_POINTER = re.compile(r"\(?\s*\bviz\s+(?:níže|dále|výše|také)?\s*(?:příloh\w*|seznam\w*|přehled\w*)?"
                      r"(?:\s+[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ][\w.]*){0,2}\s*\)?|\b(?:v|viz)\s+příloze\b", re.I)
# the clause *is* the pointer: a list named as its subject (`Přehled všech inscenací … viz`)
_POINTER_CLAUSE = re.compile(r"^\W*(?:\d{4}\S*\s+)?(?:úplný\s+|celkový\s+)?(?:přehled|seznam|soupis|výčet)\w*\b", re.I)
# a building's or a hall's founding is not a company's (rare case 51): `v Jiříkově divadle (zal. 1860)`
_BUILDING_FOUNDED = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:divadl[eaou]|budov\w*|sál\w*|sokolovn\w*|hostin\w*|arén\w*|aréně|letní\w*\s+scén\w*)\s*"
    r"\(\s*(?:zal\.|založen\w*|postaven\w*|otevřen\w*)[^)]*\)", re.I)
# D-254 Q8: a body's name — a bare `date + name` is a listed company only when it names a
# body; otherwise it may as well be a play, and the reader decides from the page (`name_only`)
_BODY_WORD = re.compile(
    r"(?i:\bspol(?:ek|ku|kem|ky|ků|kům|cích|kov\w*)\b|\bspol\.|\bjednot\w*|\bbesed\w*|\bkroužk?\w*|\bkrouž\w*|\bsoubor\w*|\bdružin\w*|\bodbor\w*"
    r"|\bsdružení\w*|\bklub\w*|\bsokol\w*|\borel\b|\bmatic\w*|\bochotn\w*|\bthali\w*|\bdivadl\w*|\bscén\w*"
    r"|\bčtenář\w*|\bzábavn\w*|\bomladin\w*|\bmládež\w*|\bdružstv\w*|\bsbor\w*|\bhasič\w*)"
    r"|\b(?:SDO|DS|DO|OS|DrO|DJ|JDO|DTJ|TJ|ČOS|ODi|ZK|KD|MKS|OB|KrDO|OJ|ČOJ|DOS|DSO|DDS|SDH|NJ|NJS|NJP|NJŠ)\b")


def event_cues(text, date_raw=None) -> list[str]:
    """The :data:`EVENT_CUES` types a clause's words point to (possibly none).

    With ``date_raw`` (the clause's leading date) a clause that is a date and a short name
    and nothing any cue reads is ``listed`` — a company recorded as active — when the name
    is a body's (:data:`_BODY_WORD`) or the date runs over years (a span or an open date: a
    play is not given for forty years); a single year and a name that may as well be a play
    (`1903 Veselosť.`) is ``name_only``, which the model reads (D-254 Q8).  The people a
    listing names (its director `r. M. Štěpaník`, its members) do not stop it being one
    (D-221: ``officers`` and ``members`` are :data:`LISTED_MAY_NAME`).  A date, an author
    and a play (``1898 Josef Štolba: Na letním bytě``) is a ``performance`` with its
    ``title`` instead, however long, when the author runs to at most
    :data:`AUTHOR_MAX_WORDS` words (audit A3) — also beside other cues (a genre word, a venue,
    a benefit: `1898 v hostinci – Tyl: Paličova dcera`), but not beside a permit, a ban or a
    pause, which are not a play staged (review of D-224).

    D-254: words inside a play's title are no cue (:func:`mask_titles`); ``hedged`` only
    where the hedge qualifies the event (:func:`hedge_applies`); a pointer to a list
    elsewhere has no type; a building's founding (`divadle (zal. 1860)`) is no ``founded``.
    """
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    if _POINTER.search(text):
        rest = _POINTER.sub(" ", _rest(text, date_raw)[0])
        if _POINTER_CLAUSE.match(text) or len(re.findall(r"\w+", rest)) <= 2:
            return []                          # the clause is a pointer to a list: nothing (rare case 108)
        text = _POINTER.sub(lambda m: " " * len(m.group(0)), text)   # the pointer cut out, offsets kept
    masked = mask_titles(text, date_raw)
    found = [label for label, pattern in EVENT_CUES.items()
             if label not in ("title", "hedged") and pattern.search(masked)]
    # rare case 3: in a cast list (`Kryšpína hrál Václav Kadlec`) `hrál` names a member's role
    if "active" in found and not EVENT_CUES["active"].search(_CAST_LIST.sub(lambda m: " " * len(m.group(0)), masked)):
        found.remove("active")
    if EVENT_CUES["title"].search(text):
        found.append("title")
    if "founded" in found and not EVENT_CUES["founded"].search(_BUILDING_FOUNDED.sub(" ", masked)):
        found.remove("founded")
    # Q4, read both ways: German plays named as not played (`usnesla nehrát německé hry`) are no
    # German theatre, as Czech ones named as forbidden are no Czech theatre
    if "german" in found and all(_negated(masked, m) for m in EVENT_CUES["german"].finditer(masked)):
        found.remove("german")
    # D-254 Q3, as written: plays given vaguely in the plural (`mnohá představení`) or over a
    # span, with no title or number, is players active, not a particular performance
    if "performance" in found and not {"title", "count"} & set(found):
        over_span = isinstance(date_raw, str) and bool(date_raw) and (
            _date_kind(date_raw) == "span" or bool(_OPEN_DATE.match(date_raw))) and not _PERFORMANCE_VERB.search(masked)
        particular = bool(_PARTICULAR_PLAY.search(text)) or bool(_repertoire_entry(_rest(text, date_raw)[0]))
        if (over_span or _VAGUE_PLURAL.search(masked)) and not particular:
            found.remove("performance")
            if "active" not in found:
                found.append("active")
    if hedge_applies(text, date_raw):
        found.append("hedged")
    if isinstance(date_raw, str) and date_raw:
        rest = text[text.find(date_raw) + len(date_raw):] if date_raw in text else text
        words = re.findall(r"\w+", rest)
        bare = not set(found) - {"hedged", "title", "company_note", *LISTED_MAY_NAME}   # a note: see below
        # beside other cues, only when a play is actually parsed (second review of D-224)
        staged = not set(found) & NOT_STAGED and not _PLANNED.search(text)
        if staged and _repertoire_entry(rest) and (bare or repertoire_plays(rest)):
            found += [label for label in ("performance", "title") if label not in found]
        elif bare and 0 < len(words) <= LISTED_MAX_WORDS and "title" not in found \
                and ("company_note" not in found or _BODY_WORD.search(rest)):
            # a body's name, or a date over years (`1851-1893 Thalia`, `Od 1885 …`): a company
            over_years = _date_kind(date_raw) == "span" or bool(_OPEN_DATE.match(date_raw))
            found.append("listed" if _BODY_WORD.search(rest) or over_years else "name_only")
            if "company_note" in found and _BODY_WORD.search(rest):
                found.remove("company_note")        # `1909 Hospodářská beseda.` names a body
    return found


#: Cues beside which a repertoire entry is not a play staged (`povoleno: Tyl: …`, `zakázáno: …`)
NOT_STAGED = {"permit", "ban", "pause"}


def cue_table(clauses: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Pre-1914 non-puppet clauses by cue type, with the remainder no cue reaches.

    ``hedged`` and ``title`` are attributes, so a clause carrying only them counts as
    having no type.
    """
    pre = clauses[(clauses["before_1914"] == "yes") & ~clauses["puppet"]]
    cues = pd.Series([event_cues(t, d) for t, d in zip(pre["text"], pre["date_raw"])],
                     index=pre.index)
    rows = [(label, int(cues.map(lambda found, lab=label: lab in found).sum()))
            for label in [*EVENT_CUES, "listed"]]
    typed = cues.map(lambda found: bool(set(found) - {"hedged", "title"}))
    rows += [("no type (only an attribute, or nothing)", int((~typed).sum())),
             ("pre-1914 non-puppet clauses", len(pre))]
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["cue", "clauses"])
    out["share"] = (out["clauses"] / max(len(pre), 1)).round(3)
    return out


def clause_report(clauses: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """Print what the splitter did: lines cut, clauses per line, the pre-1914 yield."""
    per_line = clauses.groupby(["geo_id", "line_no"]).size()
    print("\n── chronicle clauses: lines by number of clauses\n"
          + per_line.value_counts().sort_index().to_string())
    print(f"lines kept whole as reports: {int(clauses.drop_duplicates(['geo_id', 'line_no'])['report'].sum()):,}")
    print("\n── clauses by where their date comes from\n"
          + clauses["date_source"].value_counts().to_string())
    pre = clauses[(clauses["before_1914"] == "yes") & ~clauses["puppet"]]
    lines_pre = clauses[(clauses["clause_no"] == 0) & (clauses["before_1914"] == "yes") & ~clauses["puppet"]]
    print(f"\npre-1914 non-puppet clauses: {len(pre):,} (from the lines' own dates alone: {len(lines_pre):,})"
          f"; in {pre['geo_id'].nunique():,} places")
    undated = clauses[(clauses["date_source"] == "none") & clauses["years_inside"].ne("")]
    early = undated["years_inside"].map(lambda s: any(int(y[:4].replace("x", "0")) < PRE_WAR_CUTOFF
                                                      for y in s.split("|")))
    print(f"undated clauses printing a year inside: {len(undated):,}, a pre-1914 one: {int(early.sum()):,}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The author's rulings (codebook page, 2026-10-28; D-141) and the rules coder
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Role of each event type in the measure.  "Activity …" puts Czech theatre in the place
# and year; "… column" gives the type a panel column of its own; "Coded only" keeps it in
# the evidence table.  `listed` and `active` are carried by `ensembles_active`, so their
# "column" is that one.
CODEBOOK_ROLES = {
    "listed": "Activity + column", "active": "Activity + column", "founded": "Activity + column",
    "performance": "Activity + column", "title": "Column only", "count": "Activity + column",
    "attendance": "Column only", "proceeds": "Column only", "national_theatre": "Column only",
    "statutes": "Activity + column", "permit": "Activity + column", "first": "Activity + column",
    "german": "Column only", "school_church": "Activity + column", "travelling": "Activity + column",
    "venue": "Coded only", "building": "Coded only", "members": "Coded only", "renamed": "Coded only",
    "ended": "Coded only", "pause": "Coded only", "ban": "Coded only",
    "latin": "Column only",      # added with the narrower German cue (D-141), as German is
    "officers": "Coded only",    # D-221: counts on a company's own page, see COMPANY_ACT_TYPES
    # D-254: a decline is activity, possible only (Q11); a bare name that may be a play is
    # activity, no company (Q8); a company's note counts on its own page only (Q5)
    "decline": "Activity", "name_only": "Activity", "company_note": "Coded only",
}
# D-221: on a company's own page (an ensemble chronicle) a dated act of the company — its
# officers, its members, a merger or renaming, a stage or building of its own — shows that
# the company existed that year, as a bare `listed` does.  On a place's chronicle the first
# three count only when the clause names a theatre company; a venue or building stays coded only
# (`1908 postavena sokolovna` is a hall, not theatre).  Such an act alone is a point in time,
# never an open end (B1 is for a company recorded as existing on).
COMPANY_ACT_TYPES = {"officers", "members", "renamed", "venue", "building"}
PLACE_COMPANY_ACT_TYPES = {"officers", "members", "renamed"}
# D-254 Q1: a local amateur theatre body named or referred back to — also a bare `Divadlo X`
# (`Divadlo Živnostenského domu`) and a `soubor`; not a professional `divadelní společnost`
# (a travelling company), and in any case (`Ochotníci`, `Divadelní spolek`)
_THEATRE_COMPANY = re.compile(
    r"(?i:\bochotn\w*)"
    r"|(?i:\bdivadeln\w*\s+(?:spol(?:ek|ku|kem|ky|ků|kům|cích)\b|spol\.|jednot\w*|odbor\w*|kroužk?\w*|soubor\w*|družin\w*|sdružení\w*)"
    r"|\bspol(?:ek|ku|kem|ky|ků|kům|cích|\.)\s*divadeln\w*|\bdramatick\w*\s+(?:spol(?:ek|ku|kem|ky|ků|kům|cích)\b|spol\.|sdružení\w*|kroužk?\w*|odbor\w*|jednot\w*)"
    r"|\bsoubor\w*|\bthali\w*)"
    r"|\b(?:SDO|DS|DO|OS|DrO|DJ|JDO|KrDO|OJ|ČOJ|DOS|DSO|DDS)\b|\bDivadl[oaeu]\s+(?:[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ]|U\s)")
# a surname is no company (`v hostinci pana Ochotného`), nor a school's own `soubor` (Q1)
_NOT_A_COMPANY = re.compile(r"(?i:\b(?:pan|pana|panu|paní|p\.)\s+Ochotn\w*"
                            r"|\b(?:školní|školsk\w*|dětsk\w*\s+školní)\s+(?:\w+\s+)?soubor\w*)")
# an umbrella body over the companies — a district union, a regional `župa`, the central
# Matice — is no local company (Q1), and its name (`Ústřední matice divadelního
# ochotnictva`) does not make a clause name one
_UMBRELLA = re.compile(
    r"(?i:\bžup[aěuyoá]\w*(?:\s+[\w.]+){0,3}|\bokrs\w*(?:\s+[\w.]+){0,2}|\bsvaz\w*(?:\s+[\w.]+){0,4}"
    r"|\bústřední\w*\s+matic\w*(?:\s+[\w.]+){0,3})|\bÚMDOČ\b|\bÚMDO\b")
# a body that is not a theatre company: its founding is no company's (Q1, Q10)
_OTHER_BODY = re.compile(
    r"(?i:\bsokol\w*|\btělocvič\w*|\btělovýchov\w*|\bhasič\w*|\bpěveck\w*|\bzpěváck\w*|\bčtenářsk\w*"
    r"|\bpěvec\w*|\bhudebn\w*|\bvzdělávac\w*|\bživnostensk\w*\s+spol\w*|\bnárodní\w*\s+jednot\w*"
    r"|\bkatolick\w*|\bsbor\w*|\borl[aeu]\b|\borel\b)|\b(?:DTJ|TJ|ČOS)\b")
# a body founded, then theatre taken up gradually or later: a start after the founding (Q10)
_LATER_THEATRE = re.compile(r"\b(?:postupně|později|časem|pak)\b[^.;]{0,60}?\b(?:divadl\w*|hrá\w*|hrál\w*|ochotn\w*)",
                            re.I)
# Q4: a Czech word that names Czech plays forbidden or absent is not Czech played
_NOT_PLAYED = re.compile(r"\bnepovol\w*|\bzakáz\w*|\bzákaz\w*|\bnesměl\w*|\bnesm[ěí]\w*|\bnehrál\w*|\bnehrá\w*"
                         r"|\bzamítn\w*|\bnedovol\w*|\bnebyl\w*\s+povol\w*|\bneobdržel\w*\s+povol\w*"
                         r"|\bpřestal\w*|\bnechtěl\w*", re.I)
# letters only Czech uses: a title spelt with one is a Czech play (Q4: `Loupež`, `Pan Čapek`)
_CZECH_LETTERS = re.compile(r"[ěščřžůťďňĚŠČŘŽŮŤĎŇ]")
#: the model's performer kinds that are no local company (Q1) and, on a company's page,
#: another performer than the page's company (Q7, Q13)
OTHER_PERFORMERS = {"named_group", "travelling_company", "school_or_church"}
NOT_LOCAL_PERFORMERS = {"travelling_company", "school_or_church"}


def names_company(text) -> bool:
    """Does the clause name a local amateur theatre body (Q1)?  An umbrella union's name is
    read out first, so `Ústřední matice divadelního ochotnictva` alone names none."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return False
    return bool(_THEATRE_COMPANY.search(_NOT_A_COMPANY.sub(" ", _UMBRELLA.sub(" ", text))))


def czech_named(text, titles_raw: list[str] | tuple = ()) -> bool:
    """Does the clause name Czech *played* (B8 as D-254 Q4 reads it)?  A Czech word for the
    plays or players that does not stand by a negation (`české hry nepovolovány`), or a
    title spelt with a letter only Czech uses — a Czech repertoire with one German title
    is Czech."""
    if any(isinstance(t, str) and _CZECH_LETTERS.search(t) for t in titles_raw):
        return True
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return False
    return any(not _negated(text, m) for m in _CZECH_WORD.finditer(text))


def _negated(text: str, m: re.Match) -> bool:
    """Is the language word ``m`` negated in its own phrase — between the punctuation around
    it (`hrál německy, české hry nepovolovány`: only `české` is)?"""
    start = max(text.rfind(c, 0, m.start()) for c in ",;.(") + 1
    stops = [i for i in (text.find(c, m.end()) for c in ",;.)") if i >= 0]
    return bool(_NOT_PLAYED.search(text[start:min(stops) if stops else len(text)]))
ACTIVITY_TYPES = {t for t, role in CODEBOOK_ROLES.items() if role.startswith("Activity")}
EVENT_COLUMNS = ["founded", "statutes", "permit", "first", "performance", "proceeds",
                 "national_theatre", "school_church", "travelling", "german", "bilingual",
                 "latin", "attendance"]
# B9: from the national revival to the last year before the war
PANEL_FIRST_YEAR, PANEL_LAST_YEAR = 1780, 1913
# B6: school and church theatre enters the Czech measure from 1848; before, a column only
SCHOOL_CHURCH_FROM = 1848
# company evidence: a clause that records a company existing over time, not one evening
COMPANY_TYPES = {"listed", "active", "founded", "statutes"}
# B2: a chronicle company and an ensemble-list row are one company when their starts are
# this close — on years alone, since a label like SDO names many different companies
MATCH_START_YEARS = 1

_YEAR4 = r"(1[5-9]\d\d)(?!\d)"
_PLAY_BEFORE_QUOTE = re.compile(r"\b(?:hr[auy]|hru|her|činohr\w*|veselohr\w*|frašk\w*|operet\w*|představení"
                                r"|kus\w*|dram\w*|zpěvohr\w*|uvedl\w*|sehrál\w*|uveden\w*|sehrán\w*)\W*$", re.I)
# an earlier start the clause prints for its theatre (D-254 Q6): `působí aktivně již od roku 1860`
_START_INSIDE = re.compile(rf"\bod\s+(?:roku\s+|r\.\s*)?{_YEAR4}", re.I)
# an end the clause prints after its leading date: `činný do 1938`, `zanikl 1931`; the last
# one printed closes it (D-254 Q6: `do 1873 … až do roku 1880` ends in 1880)
_END_INSIDE = re.compile(
    r"(?:\baž\s+do|\bnejméně\s+do|\bdo|\bzanikl\w*|\bukončen\w*\s+(?:v\s+)?(?:r\.\s*|roce\s+)?"
    r"|\bčinn\w*(?:\s+(?:ještě|i|patrně|zřejmě|nejméně))*(?:\s+(?:v\s+)?(?:r\.|roce))?)"
    rf"\s+(?:r\.\s*|roku\s+)?{_YEAR4}", re.I)
# not a date's year (`2.4.1866 hry`), and not `kusů`, which is as often scenery as plays
_COUNT_NUMBER = re.compile(
    r"(?<![\d.])(\d{1,3})\s*(her|hry|představení|premiér\w*|inscenac\w*|činoher\w*|operet\w*)\b", re.I)
# audit 2026-11-11 A4, checked on two samples read by independent reviewers (D-223).
# `performances_min` is a MINIMUM, so a number is taken as a single year's count only when
# nothing in the clause says it is something else: an understated year is allowed, an
# overstated one is not.  On a clause dated to one year, these make it something else —
# a running total (`dosud sehráno 127`, `do té doby 227`, `za 16 let svého trvání 120`, `od
# počátku do 1892 144 her`), a rate or another stretch (`ročně`, `průměrně`, `v dalších
# letech`, `do konce`, `do roku 1914`), a request or list (`žádost o povolení 25-30`,
# `soupis 28 her`) — and an ordinal (`79. představení`, `jako 51 představení`).
# `celkem` is not among them: it mostly totals the clause's own year (`1866 celkem 6
# představení`); `již` / `už` only when it stands right before the number (`uskutečněno již
# 65 her`, not `kulisy už nemalovali`).
_COUNT_PERIOD = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:dosud|do\s+té\s+doby|do\s+tohoto\s+roku|od\s+(?:svého\s+|jeho\s+)?(?:založení|počátku)"
    r"|za\s+(?:\d+\s+let|(?:celou\s+|tu\s+)?dob\w*|svého|své|jeho|její)"
    r"|ročně|průměrně|v\s+(?:dalších|následujících|příštích)\s+letech|do\s+(?:roku\s+)?\d{4}"
    r"|do\s+konce|od\s+\w+\s+\d{4}|soupis\w*|žádost\w*|(?:ne)?povol\w*"
    # a third sample (D-223): another year or season, a habitual maximum, years of activity
    r"|následující\w*|předchozí\w*|minul\w*|min\.|uplynul\w*|sezon\w*|za\s+rok|až\s+\d+|\d+\s+(?:roky|let))(?!\w)", re.I)
_ALREADY = re.compile(r"\b(?:již|už)\s+(?:\S+\s+){0,2}?\d", re.I)
_ORDINAL = re.compile(r"(?<![\d.])\d+\.\s*představení"
                      r"|\b(?:jako|oslav\w*)\s+(?:své(?:ho)?\s+)?\d+\.?\s*(?:představení|her|hry|premiér)", re.I)
# a theatre's season numbered with the amateurs apart (`78 představení, z toho 18 ochotnických`,
# `17 představení kočovných společností a 11 ochotnických`): the amateurs' number is the count
# (`ochotnických` / `představení ochotníků`, not `25 ochotníků`, which counts people)
_AMATEUR_NUMBER = re.compile(r"(?<![\d.\-–])(\d{1,3})\s*(?:představení\s+ochotn\w*|ochotnick\w*)", re.I)
_TRAVELLING = re.compile(r"\bkočovn\w*|\bhereck\w*\s+společnost\w*", re.I)
# a date that is no single year: `od 1905`, `po 1900`, `před 1880`, `do 1943`, `kolem 1850`
_OPEN_DATE = re.compile(r"\s*(?:od|po|před|do|kolem|asi|cca|okolo)\b", re.I)
_COUNT_SEASON = re.compile(r"\b1[5-9]\d\d\s*[-–—/]\s*\d{2}\b")
# what follows `z toho` / `z nich` / `tj.` restates part of the number before it
# (`78 představení, z toho 18 ochotnických`), so it is not added
_SUBSET = re.compile(r"\bz\s+toho\b|\bz\s+nich\b|\btj\.|\bmezi\s+nimi\b|\(údaj", re.I)
# and what follows `do roku 1914` / `do konce …` belongs to a later stretch (`1911 - 5
# představení, … pak až do roku 1914 3-4 představení`; `celkem bylo do roku 2013 … 126`)
_LATER = re.compile(r"\bdo\s+roku\s+\d{4}|\bdo\s+konce\b", re.I)
_ATTENDANCE_NUMBER = re.compile(r"\b(\d{2,5})\s*(?:diváků|osob|posluchačů|lidí)\b", re.I)
_QUOTED_TITLE = re.compile(r'"([^"]{2,80})"|“([^”“]{2,80})[”“]|„([^“”]{2,80})[“”]')
# Czech named as the language or the players (české hry, čeští ochotníci, česky, Češi), not
# as a place name (České Budějovice, Česká Lípa: the word before a capital is not counted)
_CZECH_WORD = re.compile(r"\b(?:[čČ]esk\w*|[čČ]ešt\w*|Češi)\b(?!\s+[A-ZČŘŠŽÚ])")


def _title_key(title: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\W+", " ", strip_diacritics(title)).strip().casefold()


def _date_kind(raw: str) -> str:
    """``point`` (one year), ``span`` (two years joined by a dash, or a season ``1880-81``),
    ``list`` (years listed, ``1905 a 1907``, ``1902, 1906`` — each becomes a point of its own,
    :func:`_list_points`, so a number cannot be told apart by year) or ``open`` (a date with
    one bound, ``od 1905`` / ``do 1943`` / ``kolem 1850``, or none)."""
    if not raw or _OPEN_DATE.match(raw):
        return "open"
    if _COUNT_SEASON.search(raw):
        return "span"
    if len(set(re.findall(_YEAR4, raw))) >= 2:
        return "span" if re.search(r"\d\s*[-–—]\s*\d", raw) else "list"
    return "point" if re.search(_YEAR4, raw) else "open"


def _cut_short(raw: str, rest: str) -> bool:
    """The date read kept one year of a season or span the text goes on to close (`1880` +
    `-81 spolek …`, `1910` + `­-1913 a …`): the next year after a dash, or a later full year."""
    year = re.search(_YEAR4, raw or "")
    # a one-digit tail only written tight (`1895/6`, `1895-6`), not `1884 - 5 představení`
    m = re.match(r"(?:[\s­]*[-–—/][\s­]*(\d{4}|\d{2})|­?[-–—/](\d))(?![\d.])", rest)
    if not (year and m):
        return False
    first, second = int(year.group(1)), m.group(1) or m.group(2)
    if len(second) == 4:
        return int(second) > first
    # `1880-81`, and `1895/6` (second review of D-224)
    return int(second) == (first + 1) % (100 if len(second) == 2 else 10)


def _another_year_before_count(rest: str) -> bool:
    """On a single-year clause, a year printed before the first play number (`1910 … 1916-1918
    uvedli 15 her`): the number may be that stretch's, so it is no year's count."""
    first = _COUNT_NUMBER.search(rest)
    return bool(first and re.search(_YEAR4, rest[:first.start()]))


def _stated_count(rest: str, kind: str = "point") -> float:
    """The performances a clause numbers for its own date (:func:`code_clause`), or NaN.

    ``kind`` is :func:`_date_kind`.  An open date states no year's count.  On a single year a
    period, rate, request, ordinal or `již` before the number makes it no count (see
    :data:`_COUNT_PERIOD`); on a span the number is the span's (``1903-1929 … 233 her``).  Where the
    amateurs are numbered apart, theirs is the count; a number of travelling companies' is none.
    """
    if kind in ("open", "list"):
        return np.nan
    if kind == "point" and (_COUNT_PERIOD.search(rest) or _ALREADY.search(rest) or _ORDINAL.search(rest)
                            or _another_year_before_count(rest)):
        return np.nan
    # only in a season numbered as performances (`78 představení, z toho 18 ochotnických`), not
    # `čp. 38 ochotnickou družinu` or `1897-8 Ochotnické divadlo` (D-223, third sample)
    amateur = [int(n) for n in _AMATEUR_NUMBER.findall(rest)] if re.search(r"\d\s*představení", rest) else []
    if amateur:
        return float(sum(amateur))
    if _TRAVELLING.search(rest):
        return np.nan
    cuts = [m.start() for m in (_SUBSET.search(rest), _LATER.search(rest)) if m]
    own = rest[:min(cuts)] if cuts else rest
    performances = plays = 0
    for number, word in _COUNT_NUMBER.findall(own):
        if word.lower().startswith("představení"):
            performances += int(number)
        else:
            plays += int(number)
    return float(max(performances, plays)) if performances or plays else np.nan


def code_clause(text: str, date_raw, types: list[str]) -> dict:
    """What the rules read in one clause beyond its cue types.

    ``end_inside`` is an end year printed after the leading date (``činný do 1938``);
    ``count_stated`` the performances it numbers in its own time: performances and plays are
    each summed (``2 hry a 3 operety`` is 5) and the larger taken, never added (``28 premiér,
    128 představení`` is 128, a play being performed at least once); a number after ``z toho``
    is part of one before it and is not counted; a running total or an ordinal (``dosud
    sehráno 127``, ``jako 51. představení``) is no count (audit A4); ``titles`` the play
    titles, as keys — quoted, or after the author of a repertoire entry (``Josef Štolba: Na
    letním bytě``, audit A3);
    ``attendance_n`` the largest audience it numbers; ``bilingual`` a German clause that
    also names Czech.  D-254: ``end_inside`` is the *last* end printed; ``start_inside`` an
    earlier start printed for the theatre (`již od roku 1860` in a line of 1868, Q6);
    ``czech_named`` the clause names Czech played (:func:`czech_named`, Q4).
    """
    raw = date_raw if isinstance(date_raw, str) else ""
    rest = text[text.find(raw) + len(raw):] if raw and raw in text else text
    lead = [int(y) for y in re.findall(_YEAR4, raw)]
    ends = [m for m in _END_INSIDE.finditer(rest) if not lead or int(m.group(1)) >= max(lead)]
    end = ends[-1] if ends else None
    earlier = [int(y) for y in _START_INSIDE.findall(rest) if lead and int(y) < min(lead)]
    audience = [int(n) for n in _ATTENDANCE_NUMBER.findall(rest)]
    quoted_raw = [next(g for g in m.groups() if g) for m in _QUOTED_TITLE.finditer(text)]
    titles = {_title_key(t) for t in quoted_raw}
    kind = "open" if _cut_short(raw, rest) else _date_kind(raw)
    # the plays of a repertoire entry, read for the clause's own year (review of D-224: also
    # beside a quoted phrase, which may be praise, `„výtečně provedeny“`, not a title)
    year = int(re.search(_YEAR4, raw).group(1)) if kind == "point" else None
    plays_raw = [t for t, _, _ in _repertoire_titles(rest, year)] if {"performance", "title"} & set(types) else []
    plays = [_title_key(t) for t in plays_raw]
    if plays:
        titles = set(plays)               # a repertoire line's titles are its plays, not its quotes
    titles = sorted(titles)
    # a season the date read cut short is stored as its first year, which the number
    # outruns (`1880-81 … 34 představení` would all land in 1880): no year's count; nor on a
